description: Pure-Python input file generator for computational chemistry workflows. ORCA and eOn engines, TOML-driven templates, dataclass validators. Sibling of rgpycrumbs and chemparseplot.
rules: Generate inputs via pychum.engine.orca and pychum.engine.eon. Do not hand-edit engine _blocks jinja unless extending the engine.
TOML is the user-facing config. Dataclasses validate before render.
Sibling packages: rgpycrumbs (CLI / viz) and chemparseplot (parse / plot).
Docs live at https://pychum.rgoswami.me/ . Org source is under docs/orgmode/.
